title: The cyclic Galois group of a finite field
content: K is a finite field of characteristic p, an extension of its prime subfield 𝔽_p = ℤ/p of degree n = [K : 𝔽_p], so |K| = p^n. Its Galois group Gal(K/𝔽_p) is cyclic of order n, generated by the Frobenius automorphism frob : x ↦ x^p. Cyclicity is what makes the entire subgroup structure a question about exponents of a single generator — the file exploits this by proving everything first for an abstract cyclic group and only then specialising to frob.

title: The arithmetic heart: g^e ∈ ⟨g^d⟩ ⇔ d ∣ e
content: pow_mem_zpowers_pow_iff_dvd is the field-theory-free engine. The backward direction is structural: e = d·m gives g^e = (g^d)^m ∈ ⟨g^d⟩. The forward direction is a divisibility chase: from g^e = (g^d)^k (integer k) one derives g^(d·k − e) = 1, so orderOf g ∣ d·k − e (orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one); since the hypothesis gives d ∣ orderOf g, transitivity yields d ∣ d·k − e, and because d ∣ d·k the difference forces d ∣ e. The hypothesis d ∣ orderOf g is precisely the bridge from the order of g to the modulus d.
mathContext: $g^e = (g^d)^k \implies g^{dk-e}=1 \implies \mathrm{ord}(g)\mid dk-e \implies d\mid dk-e \implies d\mid e$

title: From membership to subgroup containment
content: zpowers_pow_le_iff lifts the membership criterion to the subgroup lattice: ⟨g^e⟩ ≤ ⟨g^d⟩ ⇔ d ∣ e for d ∣ orderOf g. The proof is one rewrite by Subgroup.zpowers_le (a cyclic subgroup ⟨g^e⟩ is contained in H iff its generator g^e lies in H) followed by the membership lemma. Stating it for an abstract g keeps the Frobenius result a one-line specialisation rather than a bespoke argument.
mathContext: $\langle g^e\rangle \le \langle g^d\rangle \iff g^e \in \langle g^d\rangle \iff d \mid e$

title: Headline: the order-reversing Frobenius divisor lattice
content: zpowers_frob_pow_le_iff specialises the general subgroup criterion to the Galois group by feeding in the grandparent's orderOf(frob) = n (= finrank (ℤ/p) K). For a divisor d ∣ n, ⟨frob^e⟩ ≤ ⟨frob^d⟩ ⇔ d ∣ e. The correspondence is order-reversing: a larger field 𝔽_{p^e} (with d ∣ e) corresponds to a smaller stabilising subgroup ⟨frob^e⟩ ≤ ⟨frob^d⟩ — the contravariance that defines the Galois correspondence, here made literal on Frobenius exponents.

title: Injectivity: distinct divisors give distinct subgroups
content: zpowers_frob_pow_eq_iff shows that for divisors d, e ∣ n the subgroups ⟨frob^d⟩ and ⟨frob^e⟩ coincide exactly when d = e. The proof is antisymmetry in action: an equality of subgroups gives both inclusions, hence d ∣ e and e ∣ d via the headline criterion in both directions, and Nat.dvd_antisymm collapses these to d = e. This is the subgroup-lattice counterpart of the parent's injectivity on fixed fields, making d ↦ ⟨frob^d⟩ an order-reversing embedding of the divisors of n.
